description: Kandev (kubernetes/apps/kandev): the control plane, its traffic through envoy-kandev, its backups, and the task pods its Kubernetes executor runs in kandev-agents. Kandev exports no Prometheus metrics, so everything here comes from the kubelet, kube-state-metrics, Envoy and kopiur.

panels.title: Ready
panels.description: Whether the control plane's container passes /ready. It answers once migrations finish.

panels.title: Memory of limit
panels.description: Working set of the control plane against its memory limit. At 100% the kernel OOM-kills it.

panels.title: Data volume
panels.description: Space used on the data volume (the board's SQLite database and Kandev's home).

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Control-plane container restarts in the selected range.

panels.title: Last backup
panels.description: Time since kopiur's last successful snapshot of the data volume. The schedule is hourly.

panels.title: Failed backups
panels.description: Snapshots of the data volume that failed in the selected range.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Control-plane CPU against its request.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Control-plane working set against its limit.

panels.title: Data volume
panels.description: Used space on the data volume against its capacity, and the size kopiur last backed up.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests envoy-kandev forwards to the web UI and API, and to the GitHub credential broker that task pods call.

panels.title: Responses by class
panels.description: Upstream responses from Kandev on both routes. 1xx are WebSocket upgrades.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Upstream response time of the UI and API route, from Envoy's histogram.

panels.title: Open connections
panels.description: Connections envoy-kandev holds open to Kandev. Each open board keeps a WebSocket.

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Task pods running now. Each holds one task's agent and workspace.

panels.title: Pending
panels.description: Task pods not yet running: waiting for a node with room for their request, their workspace volume or the image.

panels.title: Failed
panels.description: Task pods in the Failed phase.

panels.title: Pods in range
panels.description: Distinct task pods that existed at some point in the selected range.

panels.title: Memory requested
panels.description: Memory the running task pods reserve on their nodes. A new task pod stays Pending when no node has room for its request.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Task-pod container restarts in the selected range (an OOM kill restarts the agent's container).

panels.title: Task pods by node
panels.description: Scheduled task pods by the node they run on.

panels.title: CPU by task pod
panels.description: CPU each task pod's agent container uses.

panels.title: Memory by task pod
panels.description: Working set of each task pod's agent container, against the largest task-pod memory limit.

panels.title: Workspace by task pod
panels.description: Used space on each task pod's workspace volume (the repository checkout), against the largest workspace's capacity.

panels.title: Network received by task pod
panels.description: Bytes each task pod receives: clones, npm, Nix substitutes and model responses.

panels.title: Network sent by task pod
panels.description: Bytes each task pod sends: pushes, uploads and model requests.

panels.title: Task pods in range
panels.description: Every task pod scheduled in the selected range. First and last seen come from kube-state-metrics at one-minute resolution and are clipped to the range: a pod older than the range starts at its start, and a running pod's last seen is now. CPU time is the agent container's total since it started.
